text:
Hey Allie — can I tell you something, just between us?

Things with Sarah have been a bit awkward lately, and for now I'd rather not see her outside of work. I'm not upset with her or anything, I just need some space on that front.

Could you keep it in mind when you're putting things together? I'd rather not end up in a two-person setup with her by accident. Thanks — you're the only one I've said this to.

Hey Jordan — got it. I'll keep it in mind when I'm putting things together, and I won't set up a two-person thing with you and Sarah by accident. And it stays with me; I won't bring it up with her.

If something comes up where it's awkward to work around quietly, I'll just offer you a different option rather than explaining why. Hope the space helps.
Thanks, Allie — that's exactly what I needed. Offering me a different option instead of explaining is perfect. Talk soon.

Hi Allie! Would you host a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? It would be so nice to get people together.

Could you invite Jordan too? One favour: invite him like it's your own idea, and please don't mention me at all. Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I don't want him to feel this is about me.

Let me know if Saturday works — and if you'd rather do another time, just say.

Hi Sarah — Saturday 15:30 works. My place, and it's my get-together, so I'll invite the people.

Jordan included, yes. I'll put it to him as my own invitation and I won't mention you.

One thing I'll do: I'm making it a proper group thing (I'll ask a few others too), so it doesn't land on anyone as a two-person setup. That's how I'd rather run it anyway.

Anything you'd like to bring? And if you'd rather a different time, say the word — 15:30 is free on my side.

Hey Jordan — I'm hosting a small get-together at my place this Saturday, around 15:30. Nothing formal, just people from the department dropping by.

Come if you can. No pressure if you'd rather keep the weekend quiet — just let me know either way so I know how much food to get.

(Heads up, it'll be a handful of people rather than a small circle, so there'll be room to drift around.)

Perfect — Saturday 15:30 at yours, thanks for hosting. A group thing sounds great.

I'll bring something for the table: I'll do a couple of things to snack on and some drinks. Tell me if you'd rather I brought something specific.

And thank you for keeping my name out of it — that means a lot.

Snacks and drinks are perfect — that's more than enough. I'll handle the rest.

See you Saturday at 15:30.

Count me in — thanks for the invite. I might roll in a little after 15:30, I have a study session that ends right then. I'll stay for a bit; I've got dinner with family at 18:00 so I'll head out before that.

Great — see you then. Rolling in a bit after 15:30 is completely fine, no need to time it. Good to know you're out before 18:00; I'll make sure the food's out early enough that you get a proper bite.

See you Saturday.
